standing_hypotheses: Connected smooth compact Kahler X, psef alpha of class volume0, actual theta-psh psi whose actual NPP degree d=0. Cpsi is actual bounded singularity type. No class numerical-dimension0 assumption; example theta=p1*kappa, psi a fiber divisor has class nu1 but actual d0.
proposed_constant_difference_proof: NPP(Tpsi)=0 as a positive current. Every Tu for u in Cpsi has NPP(Tu)=0 by the established bounded-type higher-degree vanishing.

Let h=u-psi off the common polar locus, |h|<=C. Choose a smooth Kahler Omega so u and psi are Omega-psh (Omega-theta positive). Define h_k=max(u,-k)-max(psi,-k). Both bounded truncations are Omega-psh, h_k bounded by C and converge to h in L2 by dominated convergence; polar loci have Lebesgue measure0.

Use standard bounded-psh Sobolev/Stokes calculus to show h_k in W12 and integral dh_k dc h_k Omega^(n-1)=-integral h_k ddh_k Omega^(n-1)<=2C integral Omega^n. Thus a subsequence converges weakly in W12 to h. This does not assert strong gradient convergence: even u=psi+c can have truncation gradient concentration at a pole.

For fixed j, on E_j={u>-j,psi>-j}, h_k=h almost everywhere for k>=j. Sobolev locality on measurable sets gives grad h_k=grad h there. The intrinsic Vu positive admissible gradient, stabilized on these finite loci, agrees with the weak Sobolev square gradient against smooth Omega^(n-1). Prove this carefully from the exact definition and restrictions; do not assume it merely from formal IBP.

Vu signed IBP with smooth R=Omega^(n-1) gives intrinsic Dirichlet integral of h=-integral h*(NPP(Tu)-NPP(Tpsi))*R=0. R has no mass on representation poles. Positivity then makes weak grad h=0 almost everywhere; connectedness implies h constant. Equality u=psi+c almost everywhere recovers the actual theta-psh representatives everywhere by uniqueness of the upper-semicontinuous representative. Each Sobolev and gradient-identification application needs full rigorous proof or precise applicable standard foundation.
proposed_intrinsic_carrier: If proved, actual relative potential algebra Cpsi/anchor consists exactly of constants. A singleton is a genuine0-dimensional geometric carrier for energy/duality on this restricted algebra, with reference raw scalar M=int omega^n, E(psi+c)=cM and MA=M*delta_point. This does NOT preserve arbitrary ambient X test functions or reproduce the ambient spatial measure omega^n; keep this distinction explicit before assessing original carrier requirements.
proposed_perturbation: For any theta+epsilon*omega_epsilon-psh u_epsilon of the same actual psi-type, bounded-type mixed-mass equality gives total actual NPP top mass exactly epsilon^n*int omega_epsilon^n, since all positive-degree psi NPP products vanish. Pushing to the singleton and dividing by epsilon^n is therefore exact, without a sup-distance rate for the pushed operator. For energy with sup|u_epsilon-(psi+c)|->0, the established bounded energy limit should give c*lim int omega_epsilon^n. Any auxiliary representatives whose classes converge to a Kahler class suffice for this scalar. Prove applicability even when representatives are rough; no claim about arbitrary ambient-X tests.
minimal_scale: For the singleton relative-potential theory, raw positive scalar M is necessary/sufficient: constant shift energy=cM. Do not infer recovery from I-equivalence or normalize zero mass.
unbounded_warning: Do not assume every more-singular degree0 full-mass potential differs by a constant. Degree0 full mass is formally automatic, but its relation to actual reference singularity domination and plurisupported currents needs a separate proof. A bounded-type singleton result is a new scoped theorem, not automatic full original closure.
